exposure: New diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
Old diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Incidence of diabetes in the mother
Incidence of metabolic syndrome in the mother
Incidence of diabetes in the child
Incidence of metabolic syndrome in the child
cohort: The study included a total of 3,610 pregnant women from the Japan Assessment of GDM Screening Trial and Okayama University Hospital.
finding: The adoption of the new GDM criteria significantly increased the prevalence of GDM and perinatal complications, including NICU admissions, particularly in GDM patients with obesity.
